summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Engineering module including Projects, Sprint Board, Backlog, Epics, Sprints, Roadmap, Releases, Workflows, and Knowledge Base. All pages load correctly. Project type filter works with default 'Development'. Sidebar reorganization with 4 groups (Development, Planning, Insights, Documentation) verified. Found minor issue with Workflows page making HTTP request instead of HTTPS.

minor.issue: Mixed Content Error - Workflows page requests HTTP instead of HTTPS, causing request to be blocked

issues: WebSocket connection errors in console (non-blocking, preview environment limitation)

action_items: Fix Mixed Content issue on Workflows page - API call should use HTTPS not HTTP
critical_code_review_comments: Engineering Projects page correctly filters by project_type with default 'development'
Sidebar Engineering section has 4 groups: Development, Planning, Insights, Documentation - as designed
Create Project Modal has Project Type field defaulting to 'development' when opened from Engineering Projects
Knowledge Base Settings modal works correctly with icon/color pickers and delete functionality

engineering_projects_page.details: Page loads with type filter (default: Development), shows 1 project. Changing to 'All Types' shows 12 projects with type badges (Development, Other)

project_type_filter.details: Filter dropdown works. Options: All Types, Development, Design, Operations, Other. Stats update based on filter.

create_project_modal.details: Modal opens with Project Type field pre-set to 'Development'. Has tabs: Details, Team. Fields include rich text editor, dropdowns, date pickers.

sidebar_engineering_groups.details: 4 groups verified: Development (Projects, Sprint Board, Backlog, Epics), Planning (Sprints, Roadmap, Releases), Insights (Reports, Workflows), Documentation (Knowledge Base)

sprint_board.details: Shows all projects with sprint count. Can select project to view sprints. Shows active sprint status.

backlog.details: Product Backlog page shows all projects with task count, status/priority badges. Create Project button available.

epics.details: Epics Overview shows stats (1 Total Epics, 0 In Progress, 0 Completed, 12 Projects). Lists projects with Add Epic buttons.

sprint_planning.details: Shows stats (0 Active Sprints, 5 Planning, 1 Completed). Lists sprints per project with status badges (completed, planning).

roadmap.details: Timeline view showing epics (User Authentication Revamp). Has Week/Month zoom toggle and project filter.

releases.details: Shows release v1.0.0 for Project with status 'Planned', Due Apr 1, 2026. Has edit/delete buttons and New Release button.

workflows.details: Page loads but has Mixed Content error (HTTP request blocked). Shows 2 workflows: Default Task Workflow, Bug Workflow.

knowledge_base.details: Shows 2 spaces. Has search, Add Templates, Create Space buttons. Space detail shows pages, templates, stats.

kb_create_space_modal.details: Modal has Name, Description, Type, Visibility, Icon picker, Color picker. Create Space button functional.

kb_settings_modal.details: Settings modal has all fields plus Danger Zone with Delete Space button. Save Changes works.

kb_create_page.details: New Page button found on Space Detail page. Quick Start Templates available.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Engineering module fully tested. All 12 features work correctly. Only issue: Workflows page has Mixed Content error (HTTP vs HTTPS API call). Project type filter defaults to 'development' on Engineering Projects page. Sidebar has 4 groups as designed.

workflows_mixed_content.issue: Workflows page requests http://sevora-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api/workflows/ instead of HTTPS
workflows_mixed_content.potential_cause: Hardcoded HTTP URL or missing protocol in API base URL for workflows endpoint
workflows_mixed_content.mitigation: Check workflows API call in frontend code to ensure it uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL which should be HTTPS
